name: Wisconsin
overview: Wisconsin counties take tax deeds to real estate with delinquent property taxes and then sell the tax-deeded land themselves. Before a county sells, it must advertise the sale and the appraised value by publishing a class 3 legal notice. At the first attempt to sell a property, every bid below the appraised value must be rejected, and the county may accept the bid most advantageous to it. A county may sell by open or closed bid.

counties.address: County Courthouse, 730 Wisconsin Ave, Racine, WI 53403-1274 (Treasurer's Office, 1st floor north end)
counties.next_sale_note: No dated sale found. The county's In-Rem Sale Terms of Sale (sealed bid) give no sale date or bid-opening date; we found no county page listing a current or upcoming sale.
counties.how_to_bid: Sealed bids: put a completed Sealed Bid Form and a 20% deposit (money order, certified check or cashier's check payable to the Racine County Treasurer; no personal or business checks) in an envelope marked "sealed bid". Bids must be physically received in the Treasurer's Office by 11:00 am on the day of the bid opening.

evidence.quote: IN-REM SALE TERMS OF SALE – SEALED BID SALE

counties.next_sale_note: No 2026 or later sale found. The most recent county notice we found was the online Public Land Sale that began April 14, 2025 and closed May 12, 2025.
counties.how_to_bid: Online auction of properties acquired by in rem action under Wis. Stat. 75.521, on Wisconsin Surplus with staggered end times. Bids below the minimum bid are not accepted; properties are sold as is. The notice says to visit the auction site for more information and to register as a bidder.
